channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Toledo: 'Flávio Bolsonaro mentiu, omitiu e escapuliu' em sabatina na Globo
item.description: José Roberto de Toledo harshly criticized Flávio Bolsonaro following a TV Globo interview, accusing him of lying, omitting answers, and dodging questions. The PL candidate was negatively assessed for his performance in the televised debate.

item.title: Flávio diz que não é preciso mexer em aposentadorias ou no salário mínimo para fazer ajuste fiscal
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated that, if elected, he will implement fiscal adjustments without changing social security or the minimum wage. He emphasized that other measures will be prioritized for fiscal balance, without targeting specific groups.

item.title: Sakamoto: Flávio mentiu na Globo sobre Master, 8/1, Tarifaço e meio-ambiente
item.description: Leonardo Sakamoto accused Flávio Bolsonaro of lying about Banco Master, January 8, fare increases, and environmental issues during his Globo interview. The columnist labeled the PL presidential candidate's statements as a 'Grand Slam of lies'.

item.title: Sakamoto: Flávio se viu sem argumentos e inventou diálogo em reunião
item.description: Leonardo Sakamoto, a UOL columnist, criticized Flávio Bolsonaro for lacking arguments regarding the Banco Master case, inventing a dialogue between Lula and Daniel Vorcaro. The PL candidate was accused of using lies to defend himself.

item.title: Quando a corrupção faz a diferença
item.description: During a live interview on Globo TV, President Lula was asked about corruption, echoing the central theme of his 2022 interview. He emphasized institutional independence and defended the benefit of the doubt for suspects. Full content is exclusive to subscribers.

item.title: Deepfake em eleição nunca é do bem
item.description: Brazil has some of the best regulations for AI use in electoral campaigning, with TSE resolutions approved after debates and civil society input. The article emphasizes the importance of regulating deepfakes and digital manipulation to preserve electoral integrity.

item.title: Augusto Cury participa de entrevista da Globo neste sábado; saiba como assistir
item.description: Augusto Cury will be interviewed on TV Globo this Saturday at 9:20 PM, hosted by Renata Vasconcellos and César Tralli. The live broadcast follows the Jornal Nacional and is available on g1, GloboNews, and Globoplay.

item.title: Pesquisa Vox Brasil: Lula tem 37,1% no 1º turno e Flávio Bolsonaro, 34,8%
item.description: The Vox Brasil poll shows Lula at 37.1% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 34.8% in the first round, within the margin of error. In the head-to-head, Flávio leads with 45.1% versus Lula's 44.5%. The margin of error is 2.15 percentage points.

item.title: VÍDEO: De onde sai o dinheiro das campanhas políticas?
item.description: The 2026 elections in Brazil will be funded with R$5 billion, mainly from the Special Campaign Funding Fund (Electoral Fund), which distributes resources based on parties' electoral performance. PL, PT, and União Brasil will receive nearly 40% of this fund. Campaigns can also receive donations from individuals, personal funds, and fundraising events, but companies and foreigners are prohibited from contributing.

item.title: Patrimônio de candidatos do PL tem o maior aumento em quatro anos; veja o ranking dos partidos
item.description: The assets of PL candidates saw the largest increase over four years, totaling $4.9 billion, accounting for 15.7% of the $31.1 billion overall total, a 30% rise compared to 2022. Figures like Luiz Osvaldo Pastore and Wilson Picler hold much of this wealth, although 319 PL candidates declared no assets. The PL experienced an 184% increase in total asset values, with the average per-candidate wealth rising from $1 million to $3 million.

item.title: Vox: Flávio cresce, vai a 45,1%, e passa Lula, que tem 44,5%, no 2º turno
item.description: Vox Brasil poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) ahead of Lula (PT) in the runoff, with 45.1% versus 44.5%, within the margin of error. Flávio gained 4 points and Lula lost 3 since July. In the first round, Lula leads with 37.1%, followed by Flávio with 34.8%.

item.title: Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, Caiado e Augusto Cury iniciam propaganda eleitoral no rádio e na TV; o que esperar da estreia
item.description: Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, Caiado and Augusto Cury begin electoral advertising on radio and TV with times set by Chamber representation. Each candidate uses different strategies, highlighting proposals or attacking opponents.

item.title: MAPA: Quaest mostra como está a disputa presidencial nos estados
item.description: Quaest polls show the 2026 presidential race across 23 states and the Federal District. Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) either lead or are statistically tied in most regions, with Lula ahead in seven states and Flávio in another seven. Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) stands out as a third option in Goiás.

item.title: Lula ou Flávio Bolsonaro: quem foi melhor nas entrevistas da sabatina da TV Globo após o Jornal Nacional
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro were interviewed on Jornal Nacional, with their performances analyzed by GLOBO columnists. Lula faced criticism over corruption allegations involving his son and former chief of staff but was praised for his experience and defensive stance. Flávio was positively evaluated for his clarity and firm posture, particularly on education and security issues.

item.title: Quaest: veja os números da aprovação do governo Lula em 23 estados e no DF
item.description: Quaest surveys show Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leading approval in 15 of the 24 surveyed states, peaking in Maranhão (66%) and lagging in the South and Southeast. Disapproval dominates in regions like Roraima and Santa Catarina, where Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leads in voting intention. The scenario reveals strong regional polarization in the 2026 presidential race.

item.title: Caiado sobre sabatina de Flávio: "Não deu para ouvir uma proposta"
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado criticized Flávio Bolsonaro's interview on Jornal Nacional, stating the senator focused on scandals without presenting proposals on economy, health, or education. Flávio addressed topics such as the Master case, tariffs on Brazilian products, and invited Cláudio Lottenberg to lead the Ministry of Health, but avoided direct responses to criticisms.

item.title: Flávio evita aquecimento global e cita saneamento como resposta
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro claimed basic sanitation is the main environmental measure, avoiding acknowledging global warming as a human-caused phenomenon. In a TV Globo interview, the PL presidential candidate did not present climate mitigation measures in his government plan and emphasized public health actions, promising to modernize SUS and announcing Cláudio Lottenberg as Minister of Health.

item.title: Veja o que é #FATO e o que é #FAKE na entrevista de Flávio Bolsonaro à Globo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) was interviewed by Globo as part of a series of debates with presidential candidates, with the interview aired after the 'Jornal Nacional' for the first time. The 'Fact Check' team labeled as #FAKE his statement regarding the financial accountability of the film 'Dark horse', a biopic of his father Jair Bolsonaro, since the report was submitted only under public pressure and ongoing investigations. The interview schedule follows a draw among the top six candidates in the latest opinion poll.

item.title: Lula posta vídeo expondo "currículo" de Flávio: "O pior dos Bolsonaro"
item.description: Lula posted a video on social media during the Jornal Nacional interview, attacking Flávio Bolsonaro's 'resume' with accusations of irregularities, including money laundering charges and involvement in financing the film 'Dark Horse'. Flávio denied the accusations during his interview, claiming the sponsorship was private with no transfers to his account. The 2026 electoral battle intensifies with this direct confrontation between the two political leaders.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro: veja como os colunistas do GLOBO avaliaram a sabatina do candidato à Presidência
item.description: GLOBO columnists assessed Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential candidacy interview, highlighting his performance among six candidates interviewed throughout the week. The analysis covered various political and social issues, reflecting different perspectives on his positioning. The content was published following Jornal Nacional broadcasts.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro na Globo: o que disse o candidato à Presidência na entrevista à emissora
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, presidential candidate from PL, was interviewed by TV Globo and denied any wrongdoing regarding the R$61 million funding for the film Dark Horse, claiming it was a private sponsorship with no financial transfer to his campaign. He also rejected allegations of requesting millions from Daniel Vorcaro, a banker currently jailed on suspicion of multi-billion-dollar fraud at Banco Master. The interview takes place amid growing criticism over his ties to controversial figures.

item.title: TSE concede liminar a Garotinho e autoriza ex-governador a retomar atividades de campanha no Rio
item.description: The TSE granted a preliminary injunction to former governor Anthony Garotinho, allowing him to resume campaign activities in Rio de Janeiro after the state electoral court suspended his access to funding and broadcast time. Minister Floriano de Azevedo Marques deemed there is a relevant legal controversy regarding the alleged ineligibility of the Republicanos candidate, maintaining equal campaign conditions until a final ruling. The decision enables Garotinho to continue fundraising and participate in debates while his eligibility case is reviewed.

item.title: Flávio cita Lula 17 vezes em sabatina; petista evita nome de Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro mentioned Lula 17 times and criticized the current government during a TV Globo interview, while Lula avoided naming Bolsonaro, referring to his administration as 'another government'. Both candidates were interviewed on topics such as economy, security, and foreign policy.

item.title: Análise: Flávio Bolsonaro, no conteúdo, se mostrou cru e pouco crível em entrevista na TV Globo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro appeared raw and hardly credible during his interview on TV Globo, where he delivered a rehearsed speech and avoided explaining controversies such as his ties to Daniel Vorcaro and the decoration of Adriano da Nóbrega. He became uncomfortable when questioned about his past skepticism toward electronic voting and electoral integrity—issues tied to his father’s disqualification. The interview was marked by attempts at political rehabilitation and reversal of accusations.

item.title: Flávio não presta contas sobre ‘Dark Horse’ e nega relação com miliciano homenageado por ele
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro denied any irregularities in the funding of the film 'Dark Horse', claiming it was privately sponsored and not linked to public funds. He also justified the tribute to militia member Adriano da Nóbrega, deflecting criticism and attempting to link the scandal to the PT. When asked about economic policies, he evaded specifics regarding targets or deadlines.

item.title: Em comercial, PT chama Flávio de o “pior dos Bolsonaros”
item.description: The PT released a 30-second campaign ad calling Flávio Bolsonaro 'the worst of the Bolsonaros', highlighting accusations of ghost staffing, embezzlement scheme, ties to militias, and donation requests for a biopic. The campaign also launched a website with criticisms organized under corruption, betrayal, and ties to criminals. The ad marks the start of the 2026 reelection campaign for Lula.

item.title: Flávio repete “cola” de Bolsonaro durante sabatina na “Globo”
item.description: During his interview on TV Globo, Flávio Bolsonaro replicated a gesture used by his father, Jair Bolsonaro, in previous campaigns, writing keywords like 'change', 'future', and 'September 7th' on his hand. The interview was conducted by journalists César Tralli and Renata Vasconcellos in a program aired after the 'Jornal Nacional'.

item.title: Flávio é o bolsonarismo moderado, safo e ensaboado
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro appeared on TV Globo as a more moderate and polite version of bolsonarismo, avoiding his father's rudeness and aiming to attract voters who reject petism but dislike radical behavior. He avoided directly answering accusations about film funding and Jair Bolsonaro's conviction, using diversion tactics and PT attacks. Despite showing charm, he was accused of misleading and not clarifying the most sensitive aspects of his trajectory.

item.title: Flávio se esquiva sobre contrato de Dark Horse e Vorcaro: "Não cabe a mim"
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro avoided commenting on the contract transparency of the 'Dark Horse' film financing, stating that responsibility would not be his and that the case had already been clarified by the press. He emphasized that Daniel Vorcaro's sponsorship was a private relationship with no political counterparties.

item.title: Fred Trajano critica “pressa eleitoreira” e vê risco ao varejo
item.description: Fred Trajano criticized the 'electoral rush' in Congress and warned that proposals such as the end of the 6 X 1 scale and import tax changes could harm the retail sector, with hundreds of stores closing. He advocated for more time for debates before presidential elections and rejected practices driven by electoral interests.

item.title: O que estava escrito na mão de Flávio Bolsonaro na sabatina da Globo?
item.description: During a live interview on TV Globo, Flávio Bolsonaro drew attention by showing handwritten notes on his hand: 'change', 'future', and '07/09'. The phrases reflect his campaign messaging, including a symbolic reference to Brazil's Independence Day.

item.title: Anunciado por Flávio para pasta da Saúde criticou gestão de Bolsonaro na pandemia: 'Não vi grandes líderes sem máscara'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro announced Claudio Lottenberg as a potential appointee for the Ministry of Health, but the doctor had previously criticized Jair Bolsonaro's management during the pandemic, stating that the federal government failed to create an inspirational climate and emphasizing the importance of leadership in the fight against COVID-19.

item.title: Lula volta a defender política para cuidar de idosos: "Obrigação do Estado"
item.description: President Lula advocated for the creation of a public policy specifically for the care of the elderly, emphasizing that it is the State's obligation to ensure assistance and quality of life for the aging population. During a campaign event in Bahia, he highlighted the importance of reference centers where seniors can engage in social and cultural activities. The proposal reinforces Lula's focus on population aging as an achievement, integrating this agenda into his re-election campaign.

item.title: Nunes Marques promove workshop com plataformas e juízes para discutir deepfakes
item.description: TSE president Nunes Marques will host a workshop with tech companies, judges, and political parties to combat deepfakes ahead of the 2026 election. The event coincides with the court's ruling on the AI-generated video of former president Jair Bolsonaro, underscoring concerns over digital misinformation. The 'Digital Platforms in Action' project will be launched, offering training materials to judiciary and platforms on removing false content.

item.title: “Coincidência?” Vídeo da CGU com TSE registra 13 em urna
item.description: A video from CGU and TSE showing someone registering the number 13 on an electronic ballot box sparked speculation about a possible political reference. The scene was noticed by a reader of O Antagonista, but no confirmation of intentional intent from the institutions was provided.

item.title: Ao Vivo: Lula participa do evento de campanha de Jerônimo Rodrigues
item.description: President Lula attended Jerônimo Rodrigues' campaign event in Salvador, mobilizing the PT base for reelection in Bahia. The meeting included Senate candidates Jaques Wagner and Rui Costa, along with unions and social movements.

item.title: Caiado pedirá ao STF fim de sigilo sobre casos INSS e Master
item.description: Presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD-GO) announced he will request the Supreme Court to lift the secrecy of investigations involving Banco Master and suspected fraud at INSS, aiming to question opponents' transparency. He also expressed support for ending the 6-day work cycle but criticized the vote occurring in an election year and the lack of regulations for small businesses.

item.title: PT usa ‘currículo’ de Flávio para explorar denúncias de corrupção
item.description: Lula's campaign is using Flávio Bolsonaro's corruption controversies as an electoral strategy to discredit him in the 2026 race, presenting a 'report card' with four cases highlighting his allegations. The PT turns the PL candidate's controversial history into a direct attack on their main rival.

item.title: O jantar de Flávio Bolsonaro com o banqueiro André Esteves
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) hosted banker André Esteves, owner of BTG Pactual, for a private dinner in Brasília. The meeting included Marcos Trindade, co-CEO of FSB Holding, and focused on electoral polls and the current economic scenario.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Na TV, Ruas contrapõe ‘Rio real’ a cartão-postal; Paes aposta em experiência
item.description: Eduardo Paes (PSD) and Douglas Ruas (PL) launched different campaign ads for the Rio gubernatorial race, with contrasting approaches: Paes focused on his municipal management and local achievements, while Ruas nationalized the campaign by aligning with Bolsonaro and addressing public security and regional inequality. Ruas also highlighted his police background and contrasted the 'real Rio' with the 'postcard Rio', indirectly criticizing Paes.

item.title: “Não reclamo do comportamento do jornalista”, diz Lula sobre sabatina
item.description: President Lula criticized a question from journalist Renata Vasconcellos during a Globo interview but said he does not complain about journalists' behavior. He emphasized that he never expects them to ask questions to please him. The interview covered topics such as public debt and the government's fiscal record.

item.title: Relatório sobre MP do fim da ‘taxa das blusinhas’ deve ser votado na segunda-feira
item.description: The report on the provisional measure eliminating the 't-shirt tax' is scheduled for voting on Monday at the congressional commission. The MP must be approved by September 8th to prevent the return of the 20% charge on international shipments. Processing was stalled due to tensions between President Lula and Congress President Davi Alcolumbre.

item.title: “O marqueteiro do Cury contratou influencers”, diz Renan
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate from Missão, accused Augusto Cury of hiring influencers to promote his campaign on social media. He claimed his team acts ethically and is superior to the opponent's. The statement was made through a social media post.

item.title: Veja o que é #FATO e o que é #FAKE na sabatina de Augusto Cury a 'O Globo', 'Valor' e CBN
item.description: Augusto Cury took part in a joint interview conducted by 'O Globo', 'Valor', and CBN, hosted by journalists Milton Jung, Lauro Jardim, Malu Gaspar, and Maria Cristina Fernandes. His key statements were verified by the 'Fato ou Fake' project and confirmed as #FACT, including Supreme Court data and partnerships with the military police. The interview was part of a series of candidate forums in the 2026 election race.

item.title: Diretor da PF diz que corporação atua de forma autônoma e ‘livre de qualquer viés político’
item.description: The director-general of the Federal Police, Andrei Rodrigues, stated that the agency operates autonomously and free from political bias during a graduation ceremony for new agents in Brasília. His comments came one day after President Lula requested that he meet with Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça to resolve tensions within the PF following court actions involving investigations into relatives and allies of the PT leader.

item.title: Lula faz campanha na Bahia e evita questionamentos sobre ação de Lulinha em seu governo
item.description: Lula held a campaign rally in Bahia alongside Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues and Jaques Wagner, avoiding comments on family and lobbyist involvement in his administration. During a speech, he highlighted his government's actions for the state but declined interviews or questions about recent controversies, including photos of lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger with the president.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro diz que é voluntária da igreja e vendeu laranjas no semáforo
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro, former First Lady and Senate candidate for the PL party, released a campaign jingle in which she recalls selling oranges at a traffic light in Ceilândia at age 10, highlighting other life experiences such as church volunteering and entrepreneurship.

item.title: Nova lei reduz tributos sobre combustíveis e prevê incentivos para fertilizantes
item.description: President Lula signed Law Complementary 235/26, which reduces taxes on fuels and provides incentives for fertilizers, biofuels, and rare minerals, with a positive expected economic impact. The revenue loss will be offset by extraordinary revenues, and the law also benefits smart hospitals and the 2027 Women's World Cup.

item.title: Campanha de Lula usa “tracking” para minimizar falas sobre lobista
item.description: Lula's campaign used tracking polls to minimize fallout after he denied knowing lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger. Internal survey showed 73% approval of his interview, but contradicting photos were released. The campaign stated the images do not indicate any connection.

item.title: Lula ganha destaque em programas estaduais de aliados; Flávio é exibido no RJ e no PR
item.description: President Lula received more television airtime in the first electoral programs compared to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, according to a timeslot analysis released on Friday (28). The difference in visibility comes months before the 2026 elections and may reflect distinct campaign strategies.
